subject.title: docs(cli): generate and guard command reference

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this public command-catalog and plugin descriptor metadata contract as the source for generated CLI documentation?
rationale: The CI defect is mechanical, but the generated page depends on a new public CLI and plugin API whose permanent product boundary remains under open RFC review.

options.title: Accept and repair the stack
options.body: Approve the catalog and plugin metadata direction, then fix complete generator-input scheduling before merge.

options.title: Narrow to runtime inventory
options.body: Land only the operator inventory foundation and defer plugin metadata and generated docs until the contract is settled.

options.title: Pause the catalog proposal
options.body: Retain hand-authored CLI docs and redesign or close the stacked command-catalog work.

recommendation.title: Accept and repair the stack
recommendation.body: Approve the catalog and plugin metadata direction, then fix complete generator-input scheduling before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main CLI/plugin history and repository ownership evidence make @steipete the strongest available decision owner.
